mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing amphetamine plasma concentrations and cardiovascular/CNS effects; amphetamine increases cardiac workload in patients already at risk from protease inhibitors.
action: Monitor closely for amphetamine toxicity (tachycardia, hypertension, arrhythmias, psychiatric symptoms); consider alternative ADHD therapy or dose reduction of amphetamine with therapeutic drug monitoring.
